text.tspan: A current route through a closed chain
Contradictory instructions become a practical crossing.
On Saturday she crosses while the
Lifts the chain, then helps her climb.
B > A: offers passage / C > A: withdraws route / D > A: lifts barrier / E > A: replaces barrier / D > F: gives a hand / F > A: crosses despite barrier
This is a relation map, not a measured street plan or proof that either guard represents the whole Office.
